_doc: The star base's design sheet: the Infinite Ages settlement checklist (purpose, who runs it, trade, defence and weakness, three places, three people, current problem, secret, services, hooks) filled in for tier 1, the dock strip. Data only. The maps (starbase/maps.js) and the quests that come later read it; nothing here is player-facing text yet.
name: Your star base
purpose: A dead hulk you towed home and kept. It is the first place in the Drift that is yours: somewhere to land, fix the ship, eat, trade and take work.

ruler.true: You. The Relay Guild would say the Guild, because the hulk was drifting in Guild space and nobody filed the claim.
ruler.paper: A salvage claim in your name, stamped by Garrity's yard.

defence.have: A hull that has survived twenty years of drifting, and one working airlock.
defence.weakness: One berth, no turrets, no power plant to speak of. Anyone with a cutter and a grudge could walk in.

threePeople.privateGoal: find out who left the stall behind
threePeople.vulnerability: owes a debt to the Ember Syndicate

threePeople.privateGoal: buy the base from you one day

threePeople.publicGoal: keep your ship in the air
threePeople.privateGoal: read the knocking log drive the hulk came with
threePeople.vulnerability: talks to engines more than people

currentProblem: Most of the base is still sealed or cold: only the dock strip has air and light.
secret: The hulk's log drive keeps knocking three taps and a pause. It is the same knock as your licence number (Dead Weight, fragment 3).

hooks.text: Something answers the knock from deeper in the hulk.
A scav gang noticed where you towed it.
Fill the empty units: tenants come later, by talk and haggle (tier 2).
